decision.explanation: Source D1 explicitly states Guido Guerrini 'holds citizenship in the Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia' (D1S3) and confirms 'dual citizenship' (D1S9). Source D2 repeatedly identifies him as a 'renowned Italian composer' (D2S3) born in Florence, Italy (D2S4), supporting Italian citizenship. Both countries are valid answers based on the text's assertion of dual citizenship.
